title: Everything Kale Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Spread sweet potatoes in a single layer on prepared baking sheet. Drizzle with oil; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake, uncovered, for 35-40 minutes, until golden and tender.
Place greens into a large serving bowl. Top with sweet potatoes, cabbage, dried figs, dried berries, pomegranate seeds, and scallions.
Prepare the dressing. Add ingredients to a glass jar; seal tightly and shake well. Refrigerate until serving time.
Shortly before serving, toss salad with dressing. Top with candied nuts, if using.

tips.title: Make ahead
tips.text: All salad ingredients can be prepped ahead. Toss with greens and dressing before serving.

tips.title: Tip
tips.text: If using kale, discard the tough stalks and center veins.

notes: Any hearty green will work, not just kale.

history.reasoning: Intake from cookbook photos (Daniella Silver, Simple Elegance). Servings stated in source (YIELD 6-8) - used as written. Cook: bake 35-40 min, upper bound = 40.
